|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Reegesk (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “While present at a battleground site, once during each of your opponent's turns, you may look through opponent's Lost Pile and 'steal' one droid, starfighter, vehicle, weapon, or device card there into your hand to use as your own.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “During opponent’s turn, if present at a battleground site, may steal a device, droid, starfighter, vehicle, or weapon in opponent’s Lost Pile into your hand.” '''What changed:''' “While” → “During opponent’s turn, if”; removed “once during each of your opponent's turns, you”; “look through opponent's Lost Pile and 'steal' one” → “steal a device,”; removed “weapon,”; “device card there” → “weapon in opponent’s Lost Pile”; “hand to use as your own.” → “hand.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 43. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Reegesk]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Reegesk (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Reegesk]]. Code OVS3 · GEMP id 1103_43.
